summary.title: Learn Algorithms & Data Structures
summary.one_liner: The Algorithms is an open-source library of algorithm and data structure implementations across 30+ programming languages, with a guide on how to contribute.
keywords: how to contribute to open source algorithms
takeaways: The Algorithms is an open-source GitHub library of algorithm implementations in 30+ programming languages.
It lists popular categories: sorting, searching, graph algorithms, and data structures such as trees, linked lists, hash tables, heaps, and tries.
Contribution workflow: fork and clone the language repository, implement the algorithm following coding guidelines, add tests, and submit a pull request for review.
summary.summary: This landing page describes The Algorithms, an open-source resource for learning algorithms and data structures with implementations in many languages. It lists headline figures (30+ languages, 1000+ algorithms) and claims about documentation and community support. It names popular categories such as sorting, searching, graph algorithms and data structures, but the page does not include the implementations themselves. A four-step guide explains how to contribute: fork and clone, implement, test, and submit a pull request.
